The '''Underwater Kingdom''' was a place of residence for an [[Unidentified finned amphibious species/Legends|amphibious sentient species]]. Notable residents included [[Squik (amphibious sentient species)|Squik]] and [[Orcon/Legends|Orcon]].<ref name="Ewoks9">[[Ewoks (1985) 9|''Ewoks'' (1985) 9]]</ref>
